eventMetadata.context_description: The AL East wild-card race defines this pivotal four-game series at Yankee Stadium, where the Yankees (76-58) hold a three-game edge over the surging Red Sox (73-61) with both clubs chasing the top seed and home-field advantage in a potential playoff matchup. Boston’s remarkable 41-14 run since late June has vaulted them into contention despite missing starters like Garrett Crochet, Roman Anthony, and Trevor Story, though their recent 1-0 loss highlighted baserunning miscues and lefty pitching vulnerabilities. New York’s Cam Schlittler delivered 5⅔ shutout innings in the opener behind Paul Goldschmidt’s homer and Cody Bellinger’s game-saving throw, preserving a narrow lead while the clubs split the season series 5-5. A Saturday doubleheader featuring Carlos Rodón and Max Fried against Boston’s lefties adds immediate implications for rotation depth, rest, and tiebreaker positioning heading into September.
